description_en: Queries the number of shards in an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-shard-number --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id am-uf6g8w25jacm70000 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterShardNumber

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

parameters.help_en:
